name: Times cryptic crossword, Crossword book 11 No 43

clue.text: Man, for example, that’s regularly insulted
Teacher’s inclination to secure hot place for retirement
Wet blanket keeping together booty left on ship
Harsh noise in time-serving vicar’s parish
Enthusiasm more difficult for a Cockney to voice
Indication of French being involved in show
Part of the tuition a seamstress requires?
Rolling, turned round a yard or so
Beam, adroit member of opposition being arrested
Loathing displayed by hard and vengeful goddess
Standard variety of low flyer
Treeless plains, miles covered by father and son
Analyse flowing water in Hampshire
Trendy former partner freshly presented in clumsy way
View gold for Clementine’s father, perhaps?
Animal that’s spotted golf course, say
Wonderful! A pastry’s rising in layers
One summarises it in poems, it turned out
Set out plan for outside broadcast?
Go all out to make Lorna’s flat most desirable
His sick tot enters hospital, having fairly high temperature
Restriction supported by captain of industry
Poem may lack this, and reason too?
Dejected female in famous run knocked over another woman
Short-lived English friend crossing border with hesitation
Unusually courageous 11th-century pope?
Farm worker accepts pressure to renew wall-covering
Bar Beethoven originally omitted from greatest work?
A theatre cat to relish
